request: Build the backend-neutral local and managed HivemindOS app-builder with one canonical contract, local project/runtime/file adapter, managed adapter, capability discovery, and no VM requirement for local users

entries.note: file tree and file mutation operations rebuilt with local path confinement and confirmations
dependency installation adapted to argv execution with registry validation and explicit approval
runtime lifecycle and preview capability modeled once for local and managed backends
existing project registry reused as durable app-project discovery surface
existing managed-cloud Hive Action conventions adapted into one backend-neutral agent tool
